summary: Third-round regression + live UI verification for the founder's 3 findings. FINDING 1 & 2 (business_voice_filter nonpage-filename + URL mangling): re-ran the full existing pytest suite (36/36 passing, 100%) — no regression. FINDING 3 (feature flag graduation for workcard_scan_strip): verified end-to-end in the live preview UI — the DB-backed persistent ScanStatusStrip receipt WorkCard now renders correctly for a normal user after /scan and /security-scan slash commands complete, and it survives a full page reload (proving DB-backed, not sessionStorage-backed). Feature flag confirmed at rollout_pct:100 via admin API. This is the exact fix the founder needs graduated to production; the preview pod's copy is now correct.
action_items: PRODUCTION-ONLY (out of preview scope): Founder must run POST /api/aurem-dev/admin/feature-flags on auremcto.com with production admin JWT to graduate `workcard_scan_strip` to rollout_pct:100 (currently only graduated in the preview pod's Mongo). Payload: {"flag":"workcard_scan_strip","enabled":true,"rollout_pct":100,"tier_allowlist":[],"user_allowlist":[]}. Until this is done, real production users (including the founder) will continue to see the OLD legacy behavior (single 4-second toast, no durable receipt for clean scans).
OPTIONAL: Founder to reconnect GitHub App on `aurem-demo/frontend` and `aurem-demo/backend` (their tokens are revoked in this preview pod — banner is shown correctly).
critical_code_review_comments: ScanStatusStrip priority order (in_progress > receipt > just_completed(legacy) > backlog) was verified via live testing on the receipt branch. Legacy `just_completed` self-delete-on-clean bug is now moot since receipt always wins when workcard_enabled:true.
Small quality-of-life observation (not a bug): the top-right chip 'Scan clean — no critical/high issues (Run all scanners)' overlaps timestamp area on narrow widths; consider truncation.
Non-blocking: 12 projects still shown as 'unreachable' in the preview pod's switcher — could add a bulk-cleanup CTA in the banner (already partially present).

rca of the issue: Finding 3 RCA (already fixed pre-testing): ScanStatusStrip.jsx had a legacy code path where clean scans (no critical/high) explicitly removed the sessionStorage entry in markScanJustCompleted(), leaving only a 4-second toast as user feedback — easy to miss and matching the founder's report of 'nothing durable happens'. A newer DB-backed receipt branch (reads GET /codebase-health/last, renders scan-strip-receipt WorkCard that survives reload for ANY outcome) already existed but was feature-flagged behind workcard_scan_strip with rollout_pct:0 and user_allowlist:['test_admin_001'] only. Real users (including founder) never hit the fix. Mitigation: main agent POSTed to admin/feature-flags to set rollout_pct:100 in this preview pod's Mongo. This test round proves that after graduation, the receipt WorkCard renders end-to-end and persists across reloads for a normal /scan flow. Founder must repeat the same admin POST against production Mongo to make the fix visible on auremcto.com.
